_comment: Instance data for core/helpers/diagnose-gate.cjs: regex strings that EXTEND the built-ins.
failure_patterns = a tool result that reports a STATE failure of a device or service (built-ins: packet loss
above 0 %, 'unreachable', 'timed out', 'link down', 'not responding', 'connection refused'); add the wording
your own tools print. not_failure_patterns = text near a hit that makes it a guard doing its job, not a defect
(built-ins: REFUSED, PREVIEW, permission denied). log_read_patterns = a tool call that reads a log or journal
(built-ins: journalctl, 'log show', Get-WinEvent, *.log, '<tool>_logs', '/log print'); add the log tools of
your own systems - an MCP log tool, a device's log command - or the gate asks for a counter-check you ran.
Results of file and text tools (Read, Grep, a cat/grep/sed in the shell) never count: they show text, they
_cases: text = a tool result in the turn; optional command (default 'probe-device') = the call that produced
it, log_read = an earlier call of the same turn; expect block = a failure without a log read;
run by core/scripts/pattern-cases.py at every self-test.
